findings.title: Unparenthesized OR in authorization and base SQL conditions breaks operator precedence when combined with AND
findings.body: For `org` and `team` scopes, `buildOrgAuthorizationCondition` (lines 171-174) and `buildTeamAuthorizationCondition` (lines 204-207) return a top-level `OR` expression without enclosing parentheses: `(("teamId" = ...) AND ("isTeamBooking" = true)) OR (("userId" = ...) AND ("isTeamBooking" = false))`. When no filters are active (`filterConditions` is `null`), `getBaseConditions()` (line 74) returns `authConditions` directly without wrapping it in parentheses. Because `AND` has higher precedence than `OR` in SQL, any query that combines `baseConditions` with other predicates such as `WHERE ${baseConditions} AND "startTime" >= ...` (or `WHERE ... AND ${baseConditions}`) will only apply those predicates to one branch of the `OR`, returning unfiltered rows for the other branch. The same issue applies to `getFilterConditions()` when only `eventTypeId` is set (line 106). Additionally, the `else if (filterConditions)` branch on lines 76-77 would return filter conditions without authorization if `authConditions` were ever falsy; if `!authConditions`, it should always return `NOTHING_CONDITION`.

findings.title: Caching test suite was deleted instead of updated for Prisma.sql
findings.body: The `describe("Caching", ...)` tests for `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` were removed completely from `insightsBooking.integration-test.ts`, even though `InsightsBookingService` still maintains `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions`. These tests should be updated to assert the `Prisma.sql` output rather than deleted.
